title: URL Routing: TypeError: Cannot read property 'params' of undefined
body:
I'm following URL Routing tutorial: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/guides/advanced-topics.html#url-routing

But I had this error:

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'params' of undefined
ProxyComponent.render
webpack:///./~/react-router/lib/withRouter.js?:51:26
```

I suppose that is somethings related about how to setup react-router.
